Container.Name: FCaptcha
Container.Overview: Run your own CAPTCHA service for forms and other web actions. The image includes a browser widget, a demo and a server-side token verification endpoint. This template runs one instance with in-memory state.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Host port for the FCaptcha HTTP service.

Config.Name: Signing secret
Config.Description: Generate a signing key with openssl rand -hex 32. Keep this key private and retain it across container updates.

Config.Name: Verification secret
Config.Description: Generate a different key with openssl rand -hex 32. Use it only in the application backend for Siteverify.
